# v2.22-dev Release Notes

## Program compliance dashboard: one scope selector for the whole page

The program compliance dashboard (**Programs → your program**) previously had a
separate scope dropdown on each section — Tier Status, Country, Region, Theatre,
and Global reports each chose their own scope independently. That made it easy to
end up looking at, say, a tier for one theatre and a report for another.

### What's changed
- **A single "View" selector drives the page.** One **Level** dropdown (Global /
  By Theatre / By Region / By Country — only the levels the program actually uses)
  plus a **Value** dropdown for the chosen level (which theatre / region / country;
  hidden for Global) now sits at the top of the page.
- **Pick a scope once, see everything for it.** Choosing a scope shows the
  **Tier Status** (for tiered programs) and the **one matching report** for that
  scope together — no more per-section dropdowns to keep in sync.
- **Region now shows Tier Status too.** The By Region view includes the tier
  ladder (aggregated across the region's countries), consistent with the other
  levels.

### Notes
- Everything else is unchanged: the "Compliance as of" projection, per-company
  scoping, exports, the student drill-down, and all the compliance figures work
  exactly as before — they simply follow the one page-level scope now.

No action needed after updating.
